entities.name: Jayayakshya Malla
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jayayakshya Malla was the son of Jayajyotir Malla and the last Malla king of the united Kathmandu Valley from around 1428 until his death in 1482. The valley was divided among his sons after his death.
